name: Firespark Trap (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) to disable the sensor without triggering them, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the sensors

items.name: Firespark
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters the chamber

---

Effect The rune detonates in a ball of flame that fills the chamber, dealing 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 16 basic Reflex save save).

text: Magical motion sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.
